_comment: Copy to config.json and edit for your project. This example is real: it targets the curated lists where agent-workspace-architecture / signal-sweep could be listed. 'topics' and 'search_keywords' drive both fit-scoring and lane-1 search. 'watchlist' is known target lists classified directly. 'placements_path' points at a placement-health placements.json so lists you are already in are excluded. Nothing here submits anything - scan only discovers, classifies, and drafts; a human submits behind the gate.
own_tagline: patterns and reference architecture for agent workspaces
